name: DarkKnightmon
xros_req:
DigiXros Requirements [DigiXros -2] [SkullKnightmon] x [DeadlyAxemon] 
When this would be played, you may place specified cards from your hand/battle area under it. Each one reduces the play cost.
main_effect:
[On Play] Until the end of your opponent's turn, 1 of your Digimon gains ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.). If DigiXrosing, ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon. (Trash the top card. You can't trash past level 3 cards.)
[On Deletion] Reveal the top 2 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with the [Blue Flare] trait or [Twilight] trait among them to your hand. Trash the rest.
source_effect: [Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] When an opponent's Digimon attacks, if this Digimon is [GreyKnightsmon], you may switch the target of attack to this Digimon.
